description: DB-backed recurring-seat journey: 10 units at CAD100, 9 at CAD85, and 1 at CAD125 preview/finalize at CAD1890 before tax in two monthly periods with no usage rows; overview and fixed MRR agree. Existing bundle-total pricing remains unchanged.

DB-backed effective-change matrix: change 10 to 12 at the next unbilled boundary, obtain CAD2090 there while earlier periods remain CAD1890; zero units do not become one; already-billed/finalizing target periods reject edits; explicitly configured partial-period coverage remains consistent.

DB-backed period-total replacement: save 10 then replace with 12; preview is 12 units and does not consume it; minimum and tier pricing run once on the effective total; absent next-period report stays unreported without carry-forward.

DB-backed concurrency and replay: simultaneous creates yield one logical total, request replay returns the same result, replay with changed content is rejected, and competing revision updates reject the stale writer. Recreating recurring-period row IDs preserves logical total identity.

DB-backed invoice consistency: modifying/deleting a total or applicable pricing after preview invalidates generation; concurrent generation/retries consume one revision once; finalized totals cannot be edited, deleted, or recreated to bill again. Repeat under period regeneration.

DB-backed additive compatibility: separate 10 and 12 entries bill 22; per-entry minimums/tiers preserve legacy amounts; editing is replacement of that entry; an identical request retry is one event but distinct request IDs may represent legitimate identical events. Wrong-mode writes and occupied-period conversions fail.

DB-backed diagnostic matrix across absent record, explicit zero with/without minimum, billable positive, all-already-invoiced, partly invoiced, unresolved attribution, and pricing error: correct state, quantity, and action are returned; already-invoiced never prompts duplicate recording.

DB-backed mixed invoice: fixed charges with unreported usage require explicit omission acknowledgement; unacknowledged automated generation creates no partial invoice; acknowledged omission leaves the missing obligation available and later recording bills only the remainder once.

Behavioral UI route journey: opening August missing usage in September populates client/assignment/line/service and August in the actual form, distinguishes same-named contracts, selects create/edit based on existing total, and returns to the same preview. Multiple services require a chooser; dates survive reload and timezone boundaries.

DB-backed scope guards: forged cross-tenant/client/line/period identifiers, stale or out-of-assignment period links, and insufficient billing permissions fail without writes; authorized scoped operations retain intended contract/tax/profile attribution.

DB-backed reports: recurring unit and fixed bundle amounts match canonical valuation, monthly/non-monthly cadence normalizes correctly, inactive/future/superseded commitments are excluded, pure/mixed Usage labels are correct, and CAD/USD rows aggregate separately despite a different tenant currency.

DB-backed migration and transition: legacy quantities stay stored and non-billable; historical additive minimums/tiers and invoices are unchanged; explicit recurring transition at a valid boundary has no overlap/gap; outstanding records or invoices block unsafe boundaries; merely viewing/cancelling forms creates no charge or usage.

DB-backed period-total transition: existing additive periods keep their semantics, only a future eligible boundary changes mode, conflicting entries block the change, and no total is created until a separate confirmed report; invalid negative/nonfinite quantity is rejected.

Behavioral UI authoring matrix across wizard, templates/presets, editors, and overview: intent choice explains carry-forward/replace/add, unit prices and bundle allocations differ visibly, minimum labels name their scope, and legacy quantity reference offers reviewed transition actions.

Focused live UI smoke on isolated fixtures: configure and invoice recurring seats twice; replace a period count from 10 to 12; add separate consumption; resolve a prior-period missing report; verify variable/fixed currency reports and safe legacy transition. Verify persisted invoice/usage effects and cleanup without customer data.

Rendered active custom-line dialog: save additive/period-total mode with minimum and tier prices; save recurring unit pricing with positive and zero quantity; isolate multiple service controls; require an explicit recurring rate.

Rendered active editor and legacy overview: load effective usage prices, submit mode/minimum/rate at the displayed date, reload on boundary changes, block blank boundaries, surface transition rejection, and describe the manual seat handoff truthfully.

Migrated isolated PostgreSQL: create custom Usage and Fixed lines through production actions, assert persisted measurement/pricing basis and minor units, reject negative seats before mutation, and preserve earlier period pricing through the active editor action.

Isolated PostgreSQL production creation/discovery/repair actions: September assignment plus billed or draft-linked ledger; new arrears Fixed/unit and Usage/period-total lines start October 1, never return or repair September, detect and repair deliberately removed October periods, and preserve periods/candidates on repeated calls.

Rendered Automatic Invoices interactions and synthetic live wider-date-filter smoke through December 31: no pre-effective September warnings, eligible October repair refreshes the candidate list, individual and bulk repair preserve the October start, and fixtures are removed.
